manifest.title: Dataset manifest
manifest.description: The dataset manifest should be a file containing a JSON object with attributes 'train' and 'test', each of which should be a list of objects with properties 'points' (list of [x1,y1,x2,y2], containing integer representations of starting point and second point which signifies direction) and 'image_path' (relative to the manifest file).

localisation.title: Localisation weights
localisation.description: Optional path to localisation model checkpoint. If omitted, the checkpoint downloaded during model installation is used.

display_interval.title: Validation interval
display_interval.description: Epoch count between full validation/test evaluation passes and diagnostic visualisations.

visualization_samples.title: Training samples to visualise
visualization_samples.description: Maximum number of training samples saved at each validation step. Every validation/test image is always visualised.

validation_score_threshold.title: Validation score threshold
validation_score_threshold.description: Minimum center confidence used to calculate validation point and orientation metrics.

width.title: Image width
width.description: Width to transform image to (should be divisible by 32).

height.title: Image height
height.description: Height to transform image to (should be divisible by 32).

epochs.title: Training duration
epochs.description: Number of epochs to train for.
